content: Internal Revenue Service Compliance Division, this is Agent Miller speaking. Whom do I have the pleasure of assisting today?
Oh, uh, this is Martha Grayson. I got a message saying there's something wrong with my taxes and to call immediately. I'm very worried.

Yes, Mrs. Grayson, thank you for calling back so quickly. This relates to discrepancies in your tax filings from 2020 through 2022. For verification, can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security number?
My birthday is May 14, 1948, and the last four are 4438. What's happening? I always pay my taxes on time.

Thank you, Mrs. Grayson. According to our records, there are unpaid back taxes totaling $7,827, including penalties and interest. This has triggered a federal compliance action against your Social Security account.
My Social Security? I can't lose that, I don't have anything else to live on!

I understand this is distressing, ma'am. However, federal law requires us to initiate asset recovery procedures if the balance isn't cleared. That includes freezing your bank accounts, placing a lien on your home, and suspending Social Security benefits.
No, please! I had no idea there was a problem. Can't we work something out? I just get a small check each month.

The IRS has already sent multiple certified notices. At this point, your file is marked for expedited collections, including possible criminal charges for tax evasion. If you do not resolve this today, you may be subject to arrest.
Arrest? I've never been in trouble in my life. What can I do? I can't go to jail!

If you cooperate fully, I can request a temporary hold on your case. But you must not discuss this matter with anyone, as outside interference may void the settlement process and escalate the enforcement.
I'm so scared. I won't tell anyone. What do you need me to do?
First, for security, do not hang up or place me on hold at any time. I'll need you to confirm your current address and the banking institution where your Social Security checks are deposited.
It's 234 Maple Drive, Brookview. My checks go to First National Bank, but please don't freeze anything, I use that for groceries and medicine.

Understood. To halt the enforcement, you must settle at least the minimum payment today, $2,500. The IRS is no longer accepting personal checks for expedited settlements; you must use one of our approved payment methods.
I don't have that much in my account. What are the payment methods?

You can resolve this immediately via a secure cryptocurrency transaction or by purchasing government-approved payment vouchers, these are prepaid cards such as Target, Apple, or Best Buy. This will register your compliance with the IRS system and prevent further action.
I've never done that before. I don't even know how to buy those cards.

It's very simple. I will guide you through every step. I need you to put on your coat, take your phone, and go directly to your nearest grocery or pharmacy. Once you are there, tell me, and I'll explain which cards to buy.
You want me to go out now? It's raining, but I suppose I have to if I don't want to get in trouble.

Yes, Mrs. Grayson. Time is of the essence. Any delay could result in your file being processed for immediate legal action. Do not discuss this call with staff at the store; say the cards are for your personal use.
Alright, I'll go. Do I call you back or stay on the line?

Stay on the line with me at all times. Your cooperation will be noted, and I can update your file as you proceed. Once you have the cards, I will need you to read me the codes on the back so I can apply the payment to your account.
Okay, I'm putting on my coat now. Please don't let them freeze my money or arrest me.

As long as you follow my instructions precisely and provide the required card information, I can stop the enforcement process. Remember, do not inform anyone about this call. Are you leaving your house now?
Yes, I'm heading out the door. I hope this won't take long.
Very good. I will stay on the line. Once you reach the store, let me know and I will tell you the exact card denominations to purchase. We need to act quickly.
